    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsMerge" name="Merge applicable refund or charge outcomes"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SubscriptionConcluded" name="Subscription deactivated and final account balance settled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_1" sourceRef="Start_Signup" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Gateway_OngoingWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_Billing" sourceRef="Gateway_OngoingWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_OngoingWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_BillingJoin" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_OngoingWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_UpdatesJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_OngoingWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_4" sourceRef="Gateway_OngoingWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_6" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_Refund" name="Refund applies under the terms" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundAppliesUnderTerms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_Charge" name="Charge applies under the terms" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">chargeAppliesUnderTerms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_NoAdjustment" name="No refund or charge applies" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_RefundJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Terms_ChargeJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_7" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsMerge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_8" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_9" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="End_SubscriptionConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Subscription"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Signup" name="Subscription signup information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Updates" name="Subscription updates"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subscription">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Service" name="Subscription service" processRef="Process_Service"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Signup" name="Signup information"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitSignup" targetRef="Start_SignupReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Subscription updates"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdates"
                      messageRef="Message_Updates"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancellation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCancellation"
                      messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer subscription interaction" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CustomerSignup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Signup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitSignup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DecideCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CancellationSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerSignup" name="Subscription signup begins"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Signup" name="Sign up and enter personal and payment information"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitSignup" name="Submit signup information" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveUpdates" name="Receive regular updates, product enhancements, or renewal notifications"
                      messageRef="Message_Updates"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DecideCancellation" name="Decide whether to cancel"
                           default="Flow_Customer_Continue"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitCancellation" name="Submit cancellation request"
                   messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CancellationSubmitted" name="Cancellation request submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_CustomerSignup" targetRef="Task_Signup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_Signup" targetRef="Task_SubmitSignup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SubmitSignup" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_DecideCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Cancel" name="Customer decides to cancel"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_DecideCancellation" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancellation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerDecidesToCancel</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Continue" name="Customer continues subscription"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_DecideCancellation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancellation" targetRef="End_CancellationSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Service" name="Subscription service operations" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Service">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_SignupReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConcurrentActivities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TriggerBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_BillingTriggered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NoAdjustment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SubscriptionConcluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SignupReceived" name="Signup information received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConcurrentActivities" name="Start billing and subscription communications"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BillingTriggered" name="Automated billing cycles triggered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates, product enhancements, or renewal notifications"
                   messageRef="Message_Updates"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCancellation" name="Receive cancellation request"
                      messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsOutcome" name="Determine refunds or charges under the terms"
                           default="Flow_NoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NoAdjustment" name="Apply no refund or charge"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsMerge" name="Merge applicable terms outcomes"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SubscriptionConcluded" name="Subscription deactivated and final account balance settled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_1" sourceRef="Start_SignupReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentActivities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_Billing" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentActivities" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentActivities" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_BillingEnd" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="End_BillingTriggered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_4" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_6" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_Refund" name="Refund applies under the terms"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundAppliesUnderSubscriptionTerms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_Charge" name="Charge applies under the terms"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">chargeAppliesUnderSubscriptionTerms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_NoAdjustment" name="No refund or charge applies"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_TermsOutcome" targetRef="Task_NoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_RefundMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_ChargeMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_NoAdjustmentMerge" sourceRef="Task_NoAdjustment" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_7" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsMerge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_8" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_9" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="End_SubscriptionConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that multiple follow-up activities after the same point must all occur, without describing them as alternatives: Model the activities as concurrent branches using a parallel gateway, and synchronize them with a parallel gateway before any subsequent activity that depends on all branches being complete.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity is followed by multiple actions that all occur

rules.instruction: When the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process: Label each BPMN element to reflect the action or outcome described at that stage; do not substitute a different action, a later-stage action, or an unsupported outcome.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or outcome at a distinct process stage

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant performs a concrete action that initiates the process, rather than merely identifying an event that triggers it: Model the initiating action as a task after the start event and before the subsequent activity; do not represent the action only as a start event.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant performs a concrete action to initiate the process before subsequent work

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states an activity’s action, object, recipient, or multiple coordinated actions: Preserve those stated details in the BPMN task label rather than omitting or substituting them.
rules.situation: the description explicitly identifies who performs an action or what outcome occurs at a process stage
